text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер receives praise from Mejiro
McQueen
and Мэдзиро Райан after giving it
her all to win the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is inspired by how their
motivation
for the next race remains
unfazed by defeat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Convinced that she can now run well in a
bigger
race, I suggest that she run in the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mustering up the strength to keep
herself from
falling back to her reluctant
ways, Найс Нэйчер
makes up her mind to
tackle the big race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
